entities.summary: Josel of Rosheim was a German rabbi and community leader. He was the great advocate ("shtadlan") of the German and Polish Jews during the reigns of the Holy Roman emperors Maximilian I and Charles V. Maximilian I appointed him as governor of all Jews of Germany, a position which was confirmed after Maximilian's death by his grandson, Charles V.
